wiki.title: Sarah Keyeski
wiki.extract: Sarah Keyeski (née Everson; born October 25, 1970) is an American mental health counselor and Democratic politician from Columbia County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 14th Senate district since 2025.
